title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-08-28
lineage: CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (minor fix) > CDWav(tracking) > mkwact(seekable) > shn

ai_review.summary: A strong August ’68 set with a stellar Dark Star and Eleven, but the soundboard tape is low‑volume and only listenable.
ai_review.review: The performance shines – Dark Star, St. Stephen, The Eleven and Lovelight are highlighted as top‑tier moments, though Death Don't Have No Mercy falls flat. The recording is a soundboard source that suffers from very low volume and a generally below‑par mix, making it only marginally listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer gave a solid 4‑star rating praising the music but noting low volume; another gave essentially no stars, calling the audio inferior. The show is generally praised while the recording quality drags it down, yielding an overall mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low overall volume; mix is listenable but below par, lacking crispness and balance. No major dropouts reported, but the tape does not capture the full energy of the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A single‑set show that opens with high energy, builds through Dark Star and St. Stephen, peaks on The Eleven, dips on a weaker Death Don't Have No Mercy, then recovers with a strong Lovelight finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for beautiful Dark Star playing, “mach‑speed” guitar work on The Eleven, and solid soloing behind Pigpen on Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as staying close behind Jerry during The Eleven, providing tight bass support.
